independence.helpers: five separate fresh Claude Opus CLI processes, no continuation or resume
independence.mechanical_boundary: --safe-mode disables automatic context; --tools empty and strict empty MCP config prevent reading other files. Allowed content is embedded in each saved prompt.
independence.non_inputs: No expected verdicts, record, log, design notes or previous helper outputs go to Readers or Control. Exam cases are held-out validation and never used to edit this frozen package.
independence.scope: Comprehension and discrimination of the written contract, not runtime implementation or owner enjoyment.

roles.examiner: sheet and tree only; writes independent sourced scenarios
roles.challenger: sheet and tree only; independently writes adversarial sourced scenarios
roles.reader_1: sheet, tree and id/text scenarios only
roles.reader_2: sheet, tree and id/text scenarios only
roles.control: program-made ablation copy with redundant rule paraphrases stripped, plus same id/text scenarios
